articles.title: Judge allows clergy abuse claimants to sue for parish assets in Vermont Catholic bankruptcy case
articles.description:
Judge Heather Cooper said creditors can pursue not only the highest-level bank and building holdings of the state’s largest religious denomination, but also the trust-sheltered local property and possessions of nearly 70 parishes.

The post Judge allows clergy abuse claimants to sue for parish assets in Vermont Catholic bankruptcy case appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Judge Heather Cooper permits creditors to pursue assets from Vermont's largest Catholic denomination.
Claimants can target local property and possessions from nearly 70 parishes.
This ruling may affect financial resources available for clergy abuse survivors in Boston.

articles.title: Man charged with setting Spokane’s largest wildfire was contacted about 2 other blazes last year
articles.description:
Aaron F. Farinacci, of Spokane, was arrested Monday and booked on suspicion of first-degree arson in connection with the Old Trails Fire.

The post Man charged with setting Spokane’s largest wildfire was contacted about 2 other blazes last year appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Aaron F. Farinacci was arrested for first-degree arson related to the Old Trails Fire.
He was previously contacted about two other wildfires in Spokane last year.
The wildfire poses risks to air quality and safety for Boston residents due to smoke dispersion.
